duplicate_policy: Group exact raw feature duplicates before splitting; remove contradictory-label groups, otherwise keep first row; record every removal
preprocessing: StandardScaler fit only to training inputs, then clip model-space inputs to [-5,5]; this defines the deployed reference model
error_envelope: Order statistic at ceil((n+1)*(1-alpha_stage)) of per-input maximum absolute logit error over all classes and calibration key repeats; +infinity when rank exceeds n
runtime_gate: Client uses decrypted logits and calibration envelope only; return binary sign or multiclass winner iff all compatible logits have same decision; otherwise recompute requested rows at high scale then gate or ABSTAIN
boundary_policy: No margin exclusion; all held-out inputs stay in denominators

ckks.q_bits: [scale+10] followed by one scale-bit prime per dense/square layer
ckks.security_claim: Inherited declared Q/QP envelope; actual modulus size checked; not an independent security estimate

unit: case x unique source row; keys and packed slots are dependent repeats
statistical_limit: Batched slots share key/ciphertext randomness and test uses fresh keys; exchangeability for a new-key population is unproved. Nominal conformal ranks are exploratory; never claim a certified 5% risk or IID binomial bound from these observations.
timing: Record setup/key generation, encode/encrypt, evaluation, decrypt/decode, complete process time, ciphertext/key sizes and actual fallback subset. Pilot timing under shared VM load is descriptive; no speedup claim.
stopping: Complete 12 model-seed cases; negative cases retained; infrastructure retries at most 2 per command with failures logged; no policy retuning from test
